Name: Mercenary Contract
Description: A sealed writ of service, name left blank. The Sanctum's researcher knows who still answers these.

Name: Flamethrower Blueprint
Description: Scorched schematics for a brass fire-spitter. Someone clever could make this real.

Name: Sealed Warp Scroll
Description: A scroll bound in violet wax. Its seals describe a place that does not exist yet — the podium in the ruins reads them aloud and opens the way.
